name: dbmn-desktop
description: DBMN desktop app (Electron, #373). The web app's screens and shell (../web) in a locked-down window; the main process sends requests (no CORS) and, later, keeps secrets and files. Own dependencies so Electron never touches the extension's. Packaging: electron-builder.cjs.

scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage dir

author: DBMN
